summary: Source rules and emulator attack tests enforce owner/assigned-party reads, server-owned business state, private fixed-path image uploads with size/type bounds, and immutable KYC review state. This assessment covers access rules, not operator IAM or photo authenticity.
checks: No client-controlled role or approval authority
Order access requires customer or assigned captain
Offer access does not grant exact booking access
Client writes to payment, assignment, earnings and location denied
Photo namespace, stage, MIME and 8 MB limits
